maintenance_led.reason: Sells new expedition cruise and land-tour bookings to travelers; no repair or maintenance revenue.

publicly_funded.reason: Customers are private leisure travelers paying for luxury expedition cruises and land trips.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows mainly through expedition ship voyages; land brands like Natural Habitat and DuVine were bought occasionally, not as a roll-up.

mission_critical.reason: Discretionary leisure travel; customers can easily book another cruise or tour operator.
